rules.statement: A writ of mandamus should issue to remove a person's name from the list of qualified Councillors if they have entered into a disqualifying contract, unless inequitable circumstances prevent it.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold that this is a disqualifying contract under section 31 of the Ordinance of 1887. The case is therefore one in which a writ of mandamus should issue, unless there are circumstances which make it inequitable that effect should be given to the petitioner's application."

meta.parties: In the Matter of the Election of A Councillor Foe the Galupiadda Ward of the Galle Municipality
